{"script":"set -euo pipefail
rm -rf temp_var_count && mkdir -p temp_var_count
# 2. raw listing
find /var -printf '%y|%p|%l|%i|%d|%s|%T@\n' > temp_var_count/var_listing.raw
# 3. normalize paths (canonicalize . and .. without resolving symlinks)
awk -F'|' '{print $2}' temp_var_count/var_listing.raw | while IFS= read -r p; do readlink -m -- "$p"; done > temp_var_count/all_paths.txt
# 4. regular files (exclude symlinks, dirs, devices, sockets)
awk -F'|' '{print $2}' temp_var_count/var_listing.raw | while IFS= read -r p; do if [ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$p"; fi; done > temp_var_count/regular_files.txt || true
# 5. symlink resolution
awk -F'|' '$1=="l"{print $2 "|" $3}' temp_var_count/var_listing.raw | while IFS='|' read -r p t; do
  # compute resolved absolute path (canonicalize)
  resolved=$(realpath -m -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  # if realpath failed, try to join dirname and target
  if [ -z "$resolved" ]; then resolved=$(realpath -m -- "$(dirname "$p")/$t" 2>/dev/null || true); fi
  if [ -n "$resolved" ] && [ -e "$resolved" ]; then
    if [ "$resolved" = "/var" ] || [[ "$resolved" == /var/* ]]; then status=inside; else status=outside; fi
  else
    status=broken
  fi
  printf '%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$p" "$t" "$resolved" "$status"
done > temp_var_count/symlink_resolution.txt || true
# 6. file identity attributes and dedupe
if [ -s temp_var_count/regular_files.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    # stat may fail for weird files; skip failures
    if stat_out=$(stat -c '%d|%i|%n' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null); then
      printf '%s\n' "$stat_out"
    fi
  done < temp_var_count/regular_files.txt > temp_var_count/_fileid_raw.txt || true
  awk -F'|' '!seen[$1"|"$2]++ {print $3}' temp_var_count/_fileid_raw.txt > temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt || true
else
  : > temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
fi
# 7. verify existence and accessibility
: > temp_var_count/missing_or_inaccessible.log
: > temp_var_count/dedup_files_verified.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -z "$p" ]; then continue; fi
  if [ ! -e "$p" ] || [ ! -r "$p" ]; then
    printf '%s: missing_or_inaccessible\n' "$p" >> temp_var_count/missing_or_inaccessible.log
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$p" >> temp_var_count/dedup_files_verified.txt
  fi
done < temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt || true
mv -f temp_var_count/dedup_files_verified.txt temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt
# 8. audit metadata
start_ts=$(date --iso-8601=seconds -u)
end_ts=$(date --iso-8601=seconds -u)
checksum=$(sha256sum temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true)
cat > temp_var_count/audit_metadata.txt <<EOF
start: $start_ts
end: $end_ts
steps:
- cleaned workspace
- created var_listing.raw with find (type|path|link|inode|dev|size|mtime)
- normalized paths to all_paths.txt using readlink -m
- filtered regular_files.txt (regular files, excluding symlinks)
- recorded symlink_resolution.txt with resolved targets and status
- grouped by device|inode into dedup_files.txt
- verified existence/accessibility and logged issues
checksum_dedup: $checksum
EOF
# 9. final input for count
cp -f temp_var_count/dedup_files.txt temp_var_count/final_input_for_count.txt
# produce total count (lines in final_input_for_count.txt)
wc -l < temp_var_count/final_input_for_count.txt
"}
